arthrokinetics.membership_detail: A partner's earlier board role, not a fund investment: a vendor profile (MarketScreener) lists John Yianni as a director of Arthro Kinetics Ltd until 2011-07-19; he joined Earlybird Health in 2016 (https://health.earlybird.com/members/dr-john-yianni). No page loaded names an Earlybird fund as a shareholder or as an investor in any round or in the 2006 flotation (two paywalled trade-press articles on the flotation could be read by headline only). The register names tbg Technologie-Beteiligungs-GmbH as a shareholder. Listed 2018 to 2023 under 'Pre-Fund Investments' on the firm's list (https://index.commoncrawl.org/CC-MAIN-2018-51-index?url=http%3A%2F%2Fearlybird.com%2Fportfolio%2F&output=json); never on the firm's portfolio pages before 2018.
arthrokinetics.notes: German orthobiologics company (CaReS collagen-based cartilage repair), founded 1999 as Ars Arthro AG in Esslingen, with a production site in Krems, Austria. The firm's label 'IPO' is the 2006 AIM listing, since delisted. Status rests on register entries; the 2026 liquidator line is read from an abbreviated register summary, and 'private' is the alternative reading. Seat history: Esslingen, Heidelberg, Tübingen (2014), Langenscheid (2026).
